description: Observable 2026 environment indices by county x party group (DEM, REP, OTH, and ALL for the county total), with a statewide row (county = Maryland) per party group.

sources.mail: turnout_counts: family 'sent-returned', geography 'county', category 'ALL', measures sent and received; GG26 as_of 2026-10-16 (latest) over GG22 as_of 2022-11-28 (post-election final)
sources.primary_index: GP26 county-canvass total (as_of 2026-07-23) over GP22 official-turnout ALL ballots cast (four modes, as_of 2022-08-18); county level, repeated across party rows
sources.reg_momentum: voter_registration active_voters grouped to DEM/REP/OTH: 2026-09 / 2025-09; reg_momentum_2022 = 2022-09 / 2021-09; reg_momentum_2018 = 2018-09 / 2017-09

checks_passed: 2022-11-28 is the latest GG22 sent-returned snapshot
gg26 sent-returned DEM + REP + OTH sum to ALL per county
gg26 sent-returned parties are DEM, REP, OTH, ALL
gg22 sent-returned DEM + REP + OTH sum to ALL per county
gg22 sent-returned parties are DEM, REP, OTH, ALL
24 counties + Maryland (statewide) x DEM/REP/OTH/ALL, no missing values
primary_index county totals reconcile to the GP26 canvass and GP22 statewide cast
notes: The GG26 mail figures are a running count 18 days before the election; the GG22 denominators are the post-election final, so the mail indices rise as GG26 approaches.
primary_index, county_gp26_cast and county_gp22_cast are county totals repeated on each party row.
Statewide rows (county = Maryland) are sums of the county counts, with indices computed from those sums.
